summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the AI advanced-packaging / OSAT overflow node. The strongest direct public-market mappings are OSAT asset owners with advanced packaging capacity, especially Amkor and ASE Technology. The underfollowed discovery lane adds test/probe and packaging-equipment suppliers that may benefit if HBM, chiplet, fan-out, CoWoS-like, and memory-backend capacity constraints force higher capital intensity across outsourced packaging and test.
